name: Swag bag
description: A plain canvas sack with a cord tie at the neck, big enough to stuff with loot and sling over one shoulder.
notes: A stuffed canvas sack 380 mm tall, its neck gathered with a cotton cord above a short tuft. CHECK VOLUME (x39): the reference volume is the empty sack folded; the model shows it stuffed, the shape a player recognises. The reference covers the hands and arms because it is held slung over one shoulder; no hand or arm slot holds a bag, so it takes back. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Trapper pack
description: A wooden pack frame with a load shelf at its foot and a waxed canvas sack drawn shut with a cord, carried on leather shoulder straps.
notes: An L-shaped pine frame 620 mm tall with three cross slats and a 220 mm shelf, a bundle of olive canvas with its top rolled down over the front, lashed to the frame with two rawhide cords, and tan leather straps on the back. CHECK VOLUME (x6.1): the frame's open bounding box is counted against the reference's packed volume. The shelf carries the bundle. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Daypack
description: A light nylon daypack with a zipped main compartment, a front pocket and mesh bottle pockets on the sides.
notes: A red nylon pack 290 by 440 by 170 mm with a rounded top, a zipped front pocket, black mesh side pockets, a grab loop and padded straps. The tile draws the mesh opaque. CHECK VOLUME (x7.5): the reference volume is the empty pack squashed flat. Named daypack since "travelpack" reads as a trade name. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wicker backpack
description: A woven straw basket with a lid, worn on the back by two leather straps.
notes: A flared straw basket 360 mm tall with jute rings every 60 mm, a domed lid with a loop and tan leather straps on its back. Its volume and longest side match the reference. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Large gym bag
description: A large lycra duffel with a zipped top, carry handles and a pocket in one end.
notes: A lycra duffel lying on its side with black end panels, a zip along its top, two webbing handles meeting in a wrapped grip and a zipped end pocket. CHECK VOLUME (x6.3): the reference volume is the empty bag packed down; the model is the bag standing full at its real size. Carried slung over a shoulder, so it takes the back slot like the other bags. Red, 560 mm long. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
